### Principles and Analysis of Historical Masonry Structures {.unnumbered}
#### *The Strength of the Past* {.unnumbered}

Giovanni Castellazzi and Alberto Taliercio · Cambridge Scholars Publishing, 2025 · 498 pages

How masonry structures stand, why they endure and when they fail. The book
develops the mechanics of arches, vaults, domes and walls — thrust line theory,
the no-tension model, seismic action and long-term degradation — through
structural principles, case studies and visual tools, connecting historic
construction techniques with the analytical approaches used today to assess
safety and guide conservation.

Written for engineers, architects, conservation professionals and students.
